title: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Sol and Luna, boasting lower cost and fewer mistakes
slides: Is GPT-6 Sol already better than you?
OpenAI splits its flagship into two distinct models
But Sol still fails at basic logic tricks
Your existing prompts may stop working today
Test one task with Luna before rivals do
thread_text:
1. GPT-6 Sol: Better Than You?

OpenAI just split its flagship into two models: Sol and Luna. Sol is powerful but fails at simple logic tricks. Your prompts might break today.

2. OpenAI Splits Flagship

The company divided its top model into Sol for raw power and Luna for speed. This isn't an upgrade—it's a fork in the road.

3. Sol Fails Basic Logic

Despite its size, Sol stumbles on classic reasoning puzzles. That means bigger isn't always smarter, and your complex prompts may backfire.

4. Prompts Stop Working

If you rely on GPT-6's old behavior, your existing prompts may now produce garbage. The model changed under your feet.

5. Test Luna on One Task

Take a simple task you do daily and run it through Luna. If it works, you've saved time before rivals catch on. If not, you know where you stand.
